g.text: 1. A customer can purchase multiple products.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. The system calculates the cart subtotal.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. The customer can apply a discount coupon, such as

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. The customer can pay using either a card or UPI.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5. Once payment succeeds, the order is saved.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6. The customer receives an order confirmation.
